## Activity

During May 2023, North City Eye Clinic completed 568 captures as part of routine service activity. This provides the recorded level of imaging undertaken at the site for the month. The activity was reviewed as part of the regular site operations reporting process, with attention given to image quality and the timeliness of subsequent grading.

## Image quality

There were 9 ungradable captures during the reporting period. The ungradable rate was 1.6 per cent. These results should continue to be monitored through routine quality review so that any recurring problems with image acquisition can be identified and addressed. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk in accordance with local operating arrangements.

## Grading

Grading identified 134 referable results. The median lag from image capture to completed grading was 2. This measure should be considered alongside the monthly activity and image quality results when reviewing the performance of North City Eye Clinic. The site should continue to record operational issues promptly and use routine reporting to support follow-up and service improvement.
